verdict.rationale: Unleash ships a dedicated guide for scheduling feature releases at a specific date and time. It uses `currentTime` constraints with the `DATE_AFTER` operator in activation strategies, and change requests can also group changes and apply them at a specific point in time (scheduled change requests). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration, detailed documentation of scheduled change request mechanics and plan availability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can schedule flag changes and releases to happen at a specific future time

citations.quote: to release a feature at a specific date and time (for a product launch, for instance)
Add a date-based constraint by selecting the `currentTime` context field (step 1 in the below image), choosing the `DATE_AFTER` operator
You can also use them to schedule feature releases or make features available for a limited time.
Change requests also allow you to group changes and apply them at a specific point in time.
